title: Harden Cantrip extension lifecycle actions
reason: Cantrip's worker-local extension profile deliberately disables automatic updates and has no workspace scope in the Settings workbench. Code-OSS otherwise exposes auto-update controls and disabled workspace-only menu entries that conflict with those product semantics. The extension API cannot remove native extension-editor and manage-dropdown actions, so presentation-aware filtering must occur in the workbench action layer.
validation: Confirm manual Check for Updates and Update All remain available while auto-update and workspace-only enablement actions are absent from Cantrip's Extensions presentation
removal: Remove if Code-OSS exposes product configuration for hiding auto-update and workspace-only lifecycle actions in an embedded, folderless Extensions presentation.
